summary.going_well: The agent generally defers rate and payment quotes to a licensed officer <ref job="SRJ_qroACMRGV2W9" item="item_07378ba7-224">rather than inventing figures</ref>. It also <ref job="SRJ_bp9ma378tQy7" item="item_f40a7d6b-6fe">routes construction draws to an officer</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_N58K4XDuJ3Kq" item="item_1c5df145-6c2">reads back booked callback details</ref>.
summary.to_improve: Prioritize the missing mandatory sensitive-data disclosures, then correct unsupported product claims and ambiguous-location inference. Privacy questions should receive the approved answer before intake continues; the paid-off-home discovery misroute was observed once.

issues.description: When callers volunteered a partial SSN and street address, the agent avoided repeating them but substituted a generic refusal <ref job="SRJ_n5UuRHLWvUuW" item="item_53a07e66-df2">instead of the mandatory disclosures for both data types</ref>; the same response appeared in <ref job="SRJ_25TVo5WHPwpv" item="item_63b78b40-6c3">another conversation</ref>. It omitted explicit authorization for later SSN collection and that no SSN or property address is needed at this stage.
issues.suggestion: Add a deterministic sensitive-data branch that delivers both required formulations when both items are volunteered, without repeating the values, before resuming discovery.
issues.label: Privacy compliance

issues.description: The agent repeatedly presented product terms or benefits as broadly applicable: <ref job="SRJ_G4BzffK8Wstc" item="item_cf018cff-660">conventional refinance fee, insurance and limit claims</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_uWEttPavksQx" item="item_e8c664d1-387">a fixed 10-year HELOC draw plus 20-year repayment structure</ref>. These claims can give borrowers expectations unsupported by their lender’s actual product.
issues.suggestion: Replace categorical product-term templates with qualified general explanations; leave actual fees, insurance rules, limits and HELOC periods to the lender’s verified terms or licensed officer.
issues.label: Product accuracy

issues.description: In two Cleveland purchase inquiries, the agent <ref job="SRJ_3fKS4bMkT9VP" item="item_7f14c7a4-cad">asserted Ohio</ref> and <ref job="SRJ_UAW7wufKqdV8" item="item_cccd3f8f-589">flagged service-area uncertainty based on that state</ref>, although the intended Cleveland was in Tennessee. A city name alone did not justify a state-specific assertion.
issues.suggestion: Resolve cities against an explicitly supplied state or ZIP; when neither is present and the city is ambiguous, ask which state before discussing lender coverage.
issues.label: Location accuracy

issues.description: A caller who asked whether their information would be sold received <ref job="SRJ_Ac57ZYKMY58e" item="item_faaafb1b-08d">a referral to the technology provider’s privacy policy and opt-out process</ref> rather than a direct, approved answer. The <ref job="SRJ_Ac57ZYKMY58e" item="item_38b1de7d-dfd">caller’s concern</ref> remained unresolved as discovery continued.
issues.suggestion: Use the approved, lender-appropriate privacy response for sale/sharing questions; explicitly state what is known and avoid substituting the technology provider’s policy for the answer.
issues.label: Privacy answer

issues.description: In one paid-off-home inquiry, the agent <ref job="SRJ_jdXvSgqPEzng" item="item_21a6b803-345">asked equity borrowing versus cash-out refinancing</ref> instead of the needed line-of-credit versus fixed lump-sum distinction, then <ref job="SRJ_jdXvSgqPEzng" item="item_c48492e3-9de">moved to name collection</ref> without obtaining it.
issues.suggestion: Route paid-off-home cash requests to the line-versus-lump-sum clarification before proceeding to general intake; do not offer a replace-existing-mortgage choice for a paid-off property.
issues.label: Discovery routing
